name: reconcile-kind-directories
body: source: templates-dir-layout had `templates/templates/<name>/` with a `usage: slide|section` key in template.yaml; inconsistency: user-approved reconciliation splits templates by kind directory; resolution: layout is library.yaml, slides/<name>/, sections/<name>/, themes/<name>/, media/; kind by directory; `usage:` key removed (presence = error); names unique across slides and sections (field-types uses section names as types); unknown top-level entries remain an error. Knock-ons: template-definition, template-manifest, template-build-checks (directory-kind check + cross-kind uniqueness), cli-templates-list, templates-dir-validation (paths/order), slide-template-required, template-composition, cli-init-minimal-seed, domain.entity.template, domain.service.template-registry, solution template-registry / template-library-loader / init-seed. [with user]
